gaps.text: Licence texts for 10 of 116 components compiled into the shipped FFmpeg DLLs are still missing at their pins: aom b4ce2cd097b00921b0327bfb5f07b5f8361ade99 (aomedia.googlesource.com); libiconv 1df3087ba8110c7f3ed3eb5f8869b814dbbe00b0 (git.savannah.gnu.org); pixman 96c04d1b87934dc4b9396197a2dff737698ab310 (gitlab.freedesktop.org); libbluray a24f4fad4d62893de647abc8671397747b2359dd (code.videolan.org); libdvdcss 811ce97a1d4d1c9d936f4b2707f533a9ef768251 (code.videolan.org); libdvdread 0f30df53125b564ef45903714403ce0a1e6c5e9e (code.videolan.org); libdvdnav 8147ccd35e5aae4afdd21171cf7b6b4d8f179d28 (code.videolan.org); libudfread b0bc6957e7e07d5f35391f210596d9eb71cffdd9 (code.videolan.org); librist 4f45ef8f78983892d52ccd52d9f675435b23738f (code.videolan.org); xvidcore SVN r2204 (svn.xvid.org). Their hosts refuse this environment; no materially different official endpoint carries the pins.
gaps.needed_artifact: The top-level licence/copying files of each listed component at the exact pin, fetched by root (e.g. git fetch <repo> <commit>; git show <commit>:COPYING).
